divergence_when_pinned.note: How far a draw at seed 42 had moved by the time this record was written. Measured, not carried forward. The two counts answer different questions and the run ledger conflated them: every answer file keys on item_index, so positions_replaced is the one that governs whether an answer still lines up. Identified by the digests below rather than by a date, because the pool keeps moving and a number without its inputs goes stale silently.

drawn_from.recovery_note: Not inferred. The repository tree at 62afd39 was extracted and build_ceiling_study() run against it, and it returned all 250 pinned items in their pinned positions. Every value below is therefore confirmed by replay rather than read off a commit. The replay was possible because the code at that commit read data/processed/all_controls.json directly: merged_corpus_path() and its licensed overlay did not exist yet, so there is no gitignored input to guess at.

what_this_is: The provenance of the annotated ceiling study. results/ceiling_study/ceiling_items.json is the study of record: 250 items a domain expert scored by hand, and the source of the alpha-1 = 0.181 CAPEC figure this rebuild reads its metrics against. build_ceiling_study() draws from the live curated-link pool, so it answers what a study drawn today would look like, not what was scored. This file records what the scored study was drawn from, so the two can never be confused again.
